about: Who the scroll's end's people and animals are and what they do: every painted figure and animal of S7 (map/text/S7.md, u 815-2000) at its mapped spot (layout.json), and nobody else (map/BUILDING.md). Written by gen/sections/city_end/make_people.py (the casting of gen/expand/city_end_needs.md with the lead's calls of 2026-10-12: everyone from the 22 existing characters, the new official_rider playing his stand_in); rerun it when the workshop delivers characters, clips and props, or when the builder rewrites gen/sections/city_end/solids.json. figures: character (a new one plays its stand_in until it exists), do = [clip, seconds] cycles with clips the playing character has (clips_why: what is still to make), nudge = [dX, dD] (nudge_why), scale for children (scale_why), ride = the animal a rider sits on, carried_by = the figure whose prop draws a carried child, props = carried prop_<name> parts (props_why). walkers: figures painted mid-stride or carrying, walking along their painted direction from their spot and back (walkers_why). animals: each painted animal at its map position facing hind to fore, model and load from web/public/assets/animals/animals.json. No traffic.

clips_why.about: Actions the painting needs that the wanted character lacks. "to make, free": a local retarget (from:) or a trimmed clip back from gen/; "NEW take": a Text to Motion take (10 credits once); "being made": in the character's characters/<name>.json. Rerun make_people.py when they land; until then each figure plays the nearest clip its character (or stand-in, or pose fallback) has.

notes.examine_child: when it lands, the doctor must stand within reach of the child: at real size the woman's sit sets her lap about 0.5 m behind her feet, so the child (her prop) is about 1.8 m from the doctor's spot; nudge him west then (the standing woman, who stands between them on the map's line, stays clear of him behind the seated one)
notes.seats: seated figures are grounded at their feet (people.js: a ray from H + 1.2 m, and seats don't collide); each sit clip puts the hips behind the feet (HIPS, measured on the GLBs), so each seated figure is nudged until its hips sit on its built seat (solids.json seats), and the seat's top should be at the clip's seat height (SEAT_H) or the figure hovers or sinks (checks)

props_why.child_on_lap decision: the seated woman (seated_woman_child_1535) keeps her child_in_arms prop on in her sit (Meshy 32) until sit_hold_child and child_on_lap land: rendered on the GLB (char_props.py review, 2026-10-12), the child sits upright on her lap at her left knee in the sit's calm opening (t 0-4.3 s), as painted, while from 4.4 to 10 s she leans forward chin in hand and presses it into her chest. So her cycle is [sit, 1]: people.js restarts the clip at a random point of its first 3 s at each step, which holds her in that opening (switch SIT_CHILD_CALM in the script); the plain sit without the prop would leave the child invisible
